$comment: One icon per Career achievement (Mage.Server/src/main/resources/career/achievements.json). Locked and secret states are CSS treatments of the same picture.
style: Achievement emblems: one single object per cell as an ivory pictogram, ivory ink ONLY (no second ink). Each emblem fills about 75% of its cell, with a strong outer silhouette and two or three carved details inside.
